an6.46:1.2: The Cetīs were a people living to the west of , whose capital was Sahājāti on the Vettavatī river (Sanskrit _vetravatī_, modern Betwa), a tributary of the Yamunā flowing from the Vindhya ranges to the south. Apart from three discourses featuring Mahācunda there, only other other is recorded ([sn56.30]()).
